basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida organize its claims department, roles and handoffs included, to reach a target organization the executive committee approves?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Document how the claims department is organized today, roles and handoffs included, and where it falls short.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Proceed to design with the agreed priority problem areas?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target organization for claims, roles and handoffs included, in a form the executive committee can approve.

gate.label: Target model sign-off
gate.decision: Approve the target claims organization to take to the executive committee?

architect_notes: Length is an estimate of 10 to 14 weeks, based on the operating-model archetype's typical weeks, shortened for one department; confirm before quoting.
